import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotSupportBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleCoherence
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FlatKernelBase
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorObjSubstrate.TrivialisationRestrict
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleOpenLocus

/-!
# Flat reflection of the line-bundle locus

A flat local ring map is faithfully flat. Consequently a finite module whose
base change is free of rank one is itself free of rank one at every prime
in the image. This supplies the descent direction of the open line-bundle
locus used in Kleiman's divisor construction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory TensorProduct

universe u

namespace Module

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Rank-one freeness of a flat base change reflects at every contracted prime.
No faithful-flatness hypothesis is required on the original ring map. -/
theorem free_finrank_one_at_comap_of_flat_baseChange
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Flat A B] (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (e : B ⊗[A] M ≃ₗ[B] B) (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    Free (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (algebraMap A B)).asIdeal)
        (LocalizedModule (q.comap (algebraMap A B)).asIdeal.primeCompl M) ∧
      finrank (Localization.AtPrime (q.comap (algebraMap A B)).asIdeal)
        (LocalizedModule (q.comap (algebraMap A B)).asIdeal.primeCompl M) = 1 := by
  let p := q.comap (algebraMap A B)
  let Aₚ := Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal
  let Bq := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
  let Mₚ := LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl M
  letI alg : Algebra Aₚ Bq :=
    (Localization.localRingHom p.asIdeal q.asIdeal (algebraMap A B) rfl).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A Aₚ Bq := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    (by simp [Aₚ, Bq, alg, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      Localization.localRingHom, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
  haveI : Flat Aₚ Bq :=
    (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr ‹Flat A B›).localRingHom
      q.asIdeal p.asIdeal rfl
  haveI : FaithfullyFlat Aₚ Bq := FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let e' : Bq ⊗[Aₚ] Mₚ ≃ₗ[Bq] Bq :=
    AlgebraTensorModule.congr (LinearEquiv.refl Bq Bq)
        (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct p.asIdeal.primeCompl M) ≪≫ₗ
      AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A Aₚ Bq Bq M ≪≫ₗ
      (AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange A B Bq Bq M).symm ≪≫ₗ
      AlgebraTensorModule.congr (LinearEquiv.refl Bq Bq) e ≪≫ₗ
      AlgebraTensorModule.rid B Bq Bq
  haveI : Free Bq (Bq ⊗[Aₚ] Mₚ) := Free.of_equiv e'.symm
  haveI : Flat Aₚ Mₚ := Flat.of_flat_tensorProduct Aₚ Mₚ Bq
  haveI : Free Aₚ Mₚ := free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  change finrank Aₚ Mₚ = 1
  rw [← finrank_baseChange (R := Bq) (S := Aₚ), e'.finrank_eq]
  exact finrank_self Bq

end Module

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/-- On every affine chart around the image point, an invertible flat pullback
forces the original module to be free of rank one after localization. -/
theorem free_finrank_one_sections_at_image_of_flat_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat g]
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hM : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback g).obj M))
    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (y : Y) (hyV : g y ∈ V) :
    Module.Free (Localization.AtPrime (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hyV⟩).asIdeal)
        (LocalizedModule (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hyV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V)) ∧
      Module.finrank (Localization.AtPrime (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hyV⟩).asIdeal)
        (LocalizedModule (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hyV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl Γ(M, V)) = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, hU, hUle, ⟨eU⟩⟩ :=
    hM.exists_affine_trivializing_le (show y ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V from hyV)
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := (g.appLE V U hUle).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((pullback g).obj M, U) :=
    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V U hUle).hom
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) := g.flat_appLE hV hU hUle
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(X, V) Γ(M, V) :=
    module_finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation M ⟨V, hV⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨e, -⟩⟩ :=
    pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g M hU hV hUle
  let e' : Γ((pullback g).obj M, U) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U)] Γ(Y, U) :=
    sectionLinearEquivOfRestrictIso U (eU ≪≫ (unitRestrictIso U.ι).symm)
  have h := Module.free_finrank_one_at_comap_of_flat_baseChange
    Γ(M, V) (e ≪≫ₗ e') (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩)
  have hcom := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := g)
    V hV U hU hUle hyU
  rw [show algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, U) = (g.appLE V U hUle).hom from rfl,
    hcom] at h
  exact h

/-- Over a locally noetherian scheme, invertibility after flat pullback
reflects at every image point. -/
theorem image_mem_lineBundleOpen_of_flat_pullback
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat g] (M : X.Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hM : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback g).obj M)) (y : Y) :
    g y ∈ lineBundleOpen M := by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hyV, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := g y) (U := ⊤) trivial
  obtain ⟨hfree, hrank⟩ := free_finrank_one_sections_at_image_of_flat_pullback
    g M hM hV y hyV
  haveI := hfree
  exact mem_lineBundleOpen_of_free_rank_one_localized_sections_of_isFinitePresentation
    M ⟨V, hV⟩ ⟨g y, hyV⟩ hrank

/-- A flat test has invertible pullback exactly when its image lies in the
open invertibility locus. -/
theorem isLocallyTrivial_flat_pullback_iff_range_subset_lineBundleOpen
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat g] (M : X.Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial ((pullback g).obj M) ↔
      Set.range g.base ⊆ (lineBundleOpen M : Set X) := by
  refine ⟨?_, isLocallyTrivial_pullback_of_range_subset_lineBundleOpen M g⟩
  rintro hM _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact image_mem_lineBundleOpen_of_flat_pullback g M hM y

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
